Statuses.Name: Pressured
Statuses.Description: A quick strike has forced a defensive response.

Statuses.Name: Shaken
Statuses.Description: Balance is compromised; a follow-up can exploit the opening.

Statuses.Name: Exposed
Statuses.Description: Guard is open to a driving cut.

Statuses.Name: Staggered
Statuses.Description: Unable to act briefly and open to a finishing strike.

Statuses.Name: Stunned
Statuses.Description: Unable to move or attack briefly.

Statuses.Name: Marked
Statuses.Description: An archer has sighted this target for a powerful follow-up.

Statuses.Name: Pinned
Statuses.Description: A well-placed arrow briefly prevents action.
